title: Buffett's "Going to Hell" Warning [5 Stocks to Buy Before It Gets Worse]
creator: Joseph Hogue, CFA
summary: In 'Buffett's "Going to Hell" Warning [5 Stocks to Buy Before It Gets Worse]' (published 30 Sep 2026), Joseph Hogue, CFA frames a Warren Buffett warning about part of the market 'going to hell' around the 10-year Treasury hitting a 24-year high. He attributes surging rates to four forces: persistent inflation (gas-driven CPI +3.4%), Uncle Sam's $2 trillion deficit, an AI-debt boom (Goldman sees hyperscaler debt issuance at a record $420B next year), and unexpectedly strong economic growth (flash PMI at a 5-year high) forcing the Fed toward more hikes. Five stocks to buy for this regime: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) — ~$360B in cash and T-bills collecting tens of billions at high rates, with financials/insurers in its portfolio earning more interest income; CME and CBOE — both down up to 17% last month on prediction-market competition fears, beneficiaries of rate-uncertainty hedging volume with a near-term bounce coming; the VanEck gold miners ETF (GDX) as a safety bet on inflation, deficits, and dollar weakness; and Vanguard's long-term bond ETF (BLV) — a conditional buy ("a little early"), attractive once rates level off, with a ~5% dividend and a possible bounce to $70 in the next recession. Six stocks to avoid: high-debt JBLU (debt/equity 591%, negative operating cash flow) and CCL (down 26% YTD, a falling knife), plus housing-chain DHI, PHM, BLDR, and Z as mortgage rates top 7%. Notable stance flip: Bank of America (BAC) moves from AVOID (Sep 28, long-term AI threat to financials) to BUY here — Hogue explicitly splits the time horizon: rate income now, AI disruption later. Sponsored Kalshi per-futures segment and a note that he is 'deeply invested in Ethereum' are mentions, not calls.
